title: Recorded report checks
responsibility: Lists the checks and diagnostic details stored in a report.

inputs.name: ReportChecks.checks
inputs.description: Required recorded checks, supplying status, grouping, counts and optional command/output details.

inputs.name: ReportChecks.embedded
inputs.description: Optional compact presentation, defaulting to false. True omits the enclosing panel and Checks heading.

outputs.name: ReportChecks
outputs.description: Check list with statuses, available count values and expandable diagnostic details, or an explicit empty state. It displays recorded checks without executing commands.
